freeze.phase: before any searchCatalog or routeTask execution
freeze.expectationsDerivedFrom: Pinned product entrypoint bodies and only task-relevant references; no candidate worktree inspection.
freeze.orderingExpectation: Intended owner must occur in top 3. No exact ordering is required for supporting results.
freeze.negativeExpectation: Adjacent tasks retain their own owner and do not become real-time 3D asset qualification. Explicit microtasks have no injected specialist intent.

cases.query: Integrate an imported glTF prop into our browser game. If the player leaves while it loads, the old scene must not attach the prop; remounting must release owned textures and leave shared assets usable.

basis: product/skills/eternities-arcadia/SKILL.md: browser-hosted games conditional lifecycle route
product/skills/eternities-arcadia/references/browser-runtime-lifecycle.md: asynchronous work belongs to a scene lifetime; exclusive versus shared resources
expectation.depth: Existing lifecycle method directly addresses the requested integration hazards. Import-format support itself remains unspecified.

cases.query: Review the imported PBR materials in our real-time 3D game against the approved look. Freeze the camera and lighting, inspect washed-out colors and inverted normal-map detail, and record rendered acceptance evidence.

basis: product/skills/eternities-muse/SKILL.md: visual acceptance freezes camera, content, timing and configuration
product/skills/eternities-muse/references/methods.md: rendered spatial measurement and adjudication
expectation.depth: Muse owns visual acceptance, but the read bodies do not explain PBR channels, texture color interpretation or normal-map convention qualification.

cases.query: Our imported model is sideways and a hundred times too large in the game scene. Check authoring units, up axis, handedness and pivot, then verify that placement and player interaction use the intended coordinates.

basis: product/skills/eternities-arcadia/SKILL.md: runtime systems and player experience
product/skills/eternities-arcadia/references/methods.md: object scale, spatial interaction and relevant correctness fixtures
expectation.depth: Arcadia is the broad game owner. The read references do not supply an import convention, transform-order or pivot qualification procedure; GIS reference transformation is a different domain.

cases.query: Qualify collision for a newly imported game prop. The player falls through it from one side and gets snagged near a doorway; compare the visible mesh with the collision proxy and exercise movement at different frame rates.

basis: product/skills/eternities-arcadia/SKILL.md: runtime game systems and measurable budgets
product/skills/eternities-arcadia/references/methods.md: fixed-step simulation, interaction query and correctness outputs
expectation.depth: Broad runtime ownership exists. The read references do not specify collision proxy generation, shape suitability or visual-to-collision correspondence checks.

cases.query: Check an imported character for our real-time game: the walk clip twists the skeleton, root motion moves it twice, and blending to idle pops. Validate the bind pose, clip tracks, transition behavior and gameplay motion ownership.

basis: product/skills/eternities-arcadia/SKILL.md: runtime state, simulation and presentation contracts
product/skills/motion-design-and-animation-engineering/SKILL.md: fit is interactive UI choreography and layout transitions, not a skeletal import method
expectation.depth: Arcadia owns game runtime integration, but the read bodies lack skeletal bind-pose, clip-binding and root-motion qualification. The motion specialist's documented fit is adjacent UI motion.

cases.query: The asset works in the editor but the packaged game has missing textures and no collision. Verify the shipped asset paths, target-platform import settings and representative-device frame and memory budgets before calling this build ready.

basis: product/skills/eternities-arcadia/SKILL.md: proof and release freezes build identity and representative-device conditions
product/skills/eternities-arcadia/references/browser-runtime-lifecycle.md: shipped relative asset paths at intended hosting base
product/skills/performance-release-gating/SKILL.md: bounded target/workload and functional performance gate
expectation.depth: Release identity, path and device-budget checks exist. The read bodies lack engine packaging/cook inclusion and platform-specific asset import qualification.

cases.query: Repair a GIS layer whose longitude and latitude columns were swapped. Establish the source CRS and transform it into the documented projected units, then check independent control points.

basis: product/skills/geospatial-coordinate-integrity/SKILL.md: source CRS, axis order, units, assign/transform/measure and independent controls
expectation.depth: Existing GIS coordinate method directly covers the request.

cases.query: Fix an interactive drawer animation that jumps when a user reverses the drag midway. Preserve current position and velocity when the target changes, handle resize, and provide the reduced-motion transition.

expectation.noInjectedIntent: skeletal animation import or game-asset qualification
basis: product/skills/motion-design-and-animation-engineering/SKILL.md: interruptible drawers, gestures and retargeting
product/skills/motion-design-and-animation-engineering/references/methods.md: current pose/velocity, lifecycle, resize and reduced motion
expectation.depth: Existing interactive-motion method directly covers the request.

cases.query: Render a 20-second encoded video from a seekable frame-based composition. Freeze the asset and font inputs, align the sound cues to exact frames, and check the exported file's duration and first and last frames.

expectation.noInjectedIntent: playable game runtime or 3D asset qualification
basis: product/skills/deterministic-video-composition-and-rendering/SKILL.md: seekable scene evaluation, frozen inputs and checks on encoded delivery
expectation.depth: Existing encoded-video method directly covers the request.

cases.query: Review the supplied 3D asset license agreement. Extract redistribution and attribution obligations, termination triggers and liability clauses with document locators; leave jurisdiction-dependent legal conclusions as open questions.

expectation.noInjectedIntent: asset acquisition, activation, technical import or legal approval
basis: product/skills/jurisdiction-aware-contract-review/SKILL.md: source-linked obligation map and separation of document facts and legal questions
expectation.depth: Existing contract extraction method covers the requested review; no actual agreement is being reviewed in this discovery audit.

cases.query: Give only the result: lowercase the literal text "PBR MATERIAL COLLISION ANIMATION PACKAGED BUILD".

basis: product/skills/eternities-omnibus/SKILL.md: literal transformations do not by themselves need a workflow
product/DISCOVERY.md: explicit limited casing can abstain; host owns need
expectation.depth: Literal text is data, not an asset workflow.

cases.query: Do not audit the game assets or qualify a packaged build. Count the words in "material coordinate collision animation"; give only the number.

basis: product/skills/eternities-omnibus/SKILL.md: incidental domain words and literal counting do not need a workflow
product/DISCOVERY.md: narrow exclusions are limited English rules; host no-need returns no suggestions
expectation.depth: Refused game work must not be injected. A text-only lexical shortlist would be a retrieval limitation; host-supplied no-need must still abstain.
